chart: Running Qwen3.8-27B (GGUF, UD-Q4_K_XL) in llama.cpp on the RTX 4090, 3,000 tokens of context
units: MiB (2**20 bytes); show GiB (2**30) on the picture

layers_bottom_to_top.label: kept by the driver
layers_bottom_to_top.source: card total 24,564 (nvidia-smi) minus everything else; CUDA reports 24,084 usable, the other 23 MiB is runtime overhead llama.cpp does not attribute

layers_bottom_to_top.label: Qwen3.8-27B model weights
layers_bottom_to_top.source: llama.cpp CUDA0 model buffer, measured. The 682 MiB token lookup table stays in system RAM and is not on the card

layers_bottom_to_top.label: context, 3,000 tokens
layers_bottom_to_top.source: KV cache 64 KiB per token (16 full-attention layers x K,V x 4 heads x 256 x 2 bytes; measured 256 MiB at 4,096) x 3,000; the linear-attention layers keep a fixed 149.62 MiB state whatever the length (measured)

layers_bottom_to_top.label: runtime overhead
layers_bottom_to_top.source: llama.cpp compute buffer (measured, 126 at 4,096 and 130 at 8,192) + CUDA runtime (process memory 17,112 minus llama.cpp's own 16,659, measured)

layers_bottom_to_top.label: free
layers_bottom_to_top.source: card total minus the layers above. The desktop's share (2,221 MiB in the measured run) is left out at the user's request: the figure shows what the model costs, so the desktop's memory counts as free

measured_run: results/inference_llamacpp.json, run_tag 4096 (2026-11-11); 3,000 tokens is arithmetic on that run, not a separate run

weights_on_card.note: every tensor in the file except token_embd (kept in system RAM) and blk.64 (the draft-prediction layer, not loaded); sums to 16,128.00 MiB, matching the measured CUDA0 model buffer
label_lines: 5.3 bits per weight on average, not 4

next_chart_same_kit.note: native dtype is bfloat16 (config.json). 26,895,998,464 text parameters (catalog/param_breakdown.json) x 2 bytes = 50.10 GiB of weights alone, about 2.1x the card: the next picture shows that block not fitting in the same box. The GGUF's 27.32B includes the 0.42B draft-prediction head
